lines.en: I'm Peppa Pig. This is my little brother, George. This is Mummy Pig. And this is Daddy Pig.
lines.zh: 我是小猪佩奇。这是我的弟弟乔治，这是猪妈妈，这是猪爸爸。

lines.en: Babysitting. Mummy Pig and Daddy Pig are going out for the evening. Granny Pig and Grandpa Pig are going to babysit.
lines.zh: 照看孩子。猪妈妈和猪爸爸晚上要出门。猪奶奶和猪爷爷来照看孩子。

lines.en: Hello, my little ones! Hello. Peppa, George, into your beds, quick!
lines.zh: 你们好，我的小宝贝们！你们好。佩奇，乔治，快上床去！

lines.en: Good night, my little piggies. Good night, sleep tight. Good night, Mummy. Good night, Daddy.
lines.zh: 晚安，我的小猪们。晚安，睡个好觉。晚安，妈妈。晚安，爸爸。

lines.en: What little darlings. Now go to sleep quickly. Yes, Mummy. So well behaved.
lines.zh: 多可爱的小宝贝呀。现在快点睡觉吧。好的，妈妈。真听话。

lines.en: Mummy Pig and Daddy Pig are leaving for their evening out.
lines.zh: 猪妈妈和猪爸爸出门去过夜生活了。

lines.en: Peppa and George are so good, they just fell asleep when Mummy Pig told them to. This babysitting is easy.
lines.zh: 佩奇和乔治真乖，猪妈妈一叫他们睡就睡着了。照看孩子真容易。

lines.en: George? George, are you awake?
lines.zh: 乔治？乔治，你醒着吗？

lines.en: What strange noises. I wonder if we should check upstairs.
lines.zh: 什么奇怪的声音。我们要不要上楼去看看。

lines.en: Peppa, George, are you awake?
lines.zh: 佩奇，乔治，你们醒着吗？

lines.en: Well, I never. Fast asleep. So it wasn't Peppa and George making all that noise.
lines.zh: 哎呀，真没想到。睡得正香呢。所以刚才那些声音不是佩奇和乔治弄出来的。

lines.en: I can't hear anything. I think they really have fallen asleep. Let's watch some television.
lines.zh: 我什么也听不见。我想他们是真的睡着了。我们看会儿电视吧。

lines.en: Gardening today. We are talking about roses. Oh, I love gardening programmes.
lines.zh: 今天的园艺节目。我们来聊聊玫瑰。哦，我喜欢园艺节目。

lines.en: This is a particularly thorny rose. To prune it, start by lopping off the head, and then snip away the budding shoots.
lines.zh: 这是一种刺特别多的玫瑰。要修剪它，先把顶端的花头剪掉，然后把新长出来的嫩芽剪掉。

lines.en: Granny Pig, Peppa, George, you should be in bed asleep. George and I aren't sleeping at all. Can we watch TV with you? Well, I suppose watching a little TV might make you sleepy.
lines.zh: 猪奶奶，佩奇，乔治，你们应该躺在床上睡觉。乔治和我根本睡不着。我们能和你们一起看电视吗？嗯，我想看一会儿电视也许能让你们犯困。

lines.en: Hooray! Icelandic roses are a rare treat for the discerning horticulturalist, but they are prone to drooping in temperate habitats.
lines.zh: 太好啦！冰岛玫瑰对有品位的园艺爱好者来说是难得的享受，不过它们在温带气候里容易垂头。

lines.en: This programme is very boring. Grandpa Pig, can you play that game where you throw us up and catch us? Okay, but just one turn each.
lines.zh: 这个节目真无聊。猪爷爷，你能玩那个把我们抛起来再接住的游戏吗？好吧，但每人只能玩一次。

lines.en: Oh, you seem heavier than before. Now it's George's turn.
lines.zh: 哦，你看起来比以前重了。现在轮到乔治了。

lines.en: Me! Higher! Maybe Grandpa Pig is a bit tired.
lines.zh: 我！再高一点！也许猪爷爷有点累了。

lines.en: I know, Granny Pig, let's play catch. Uh, you're it! Catch us if you can!
lines.zh: 我知道了，猪奶奶，我们玩接球吧。呃，你来抓！有本事就抓到我们！

lines.en: Catch me! I'm going to catch you!
lines.zh: 来抓我呀！我要抓到你！

lines.en: Mummy Pig and Daddy Pig are back home. I hope our little piggies are asleep. Hello? Anyone here?
lines.zh: 猪妈妈和猪爸爸回家了。希望我们的小猪们已经睡着了。喂？有人在吗？

lines.en: Yes, the little piggies are asleep, and so are the big piggies!
lines.zh: 在呢，小猪们睡着了，大猪们也睡着啦！
